findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application uses PHP session-based authentication with cookie-based login. No OAuth2 client credentials flow, no API key authentication with principal attribution, no mTLS, and no service account mechanism exists.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication mechanism. The only auth path is human-oriented session login.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials flow or API key authentication with per-agent identity attribution for programmatic callers.

findings.title: No Idempotency on Write Operations
findings.description: Write endpoints (POST /api/orders, POST /api/returns, etc.) do not support idempotency keys. Each POST creates a new record unconditionally using uniqid() for IDs.
findings.gap: No idempotency key support, no deduplication mechanism. Duplicate requests create duplicate records.
findings.recommendation: Implement Idempotency-Key header support with server-side deduplication table and TTL.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanism on write endpoints.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: API-Q4 resolved as BLOCKER because agent_scope is write-enabled and all write endpoints use uniqid() without idempotency key checks. Agents retrying failed requests will create duplicate records.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: The application logs order status changes to a mutable MySQL table (order_status_history). No CloudTrail configuration, no immutable log storage (S3 Object Lock), no tamper-evident audit trail.
findings.gap: No immutable audit trail for write operations. Existing logs can be modified or deleted.
findings.recommendation: Enable CloudTrail with log file validation and configure S3 bucket with Object Lock for immutable audit storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no immutable audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: AUTH-Q6 resolved as BLOCKER because agent_scope is write-enabled and the only audit mechanism is a mutable MySQL table. No CloudTrail or immutable log storage is configured.

findings.title: No Compensation/Rollback for Multi-Step Workflows
findings.description: The fulfillment workflow (validate → assign-warehouse → pick → pack → quality-check → ship) has no saga pattern or compensation logic. Each step commits independently with no undo mechanism.
findings.gap: No compensation or rollback for multi-step workflows. Partial failures leave the system in an inconsistent state.
findings.recommendation: Implement compensating actions for each workflow step or adopt a saga pattern with explicit rollback states.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation logic for multi-step fulfillment workflow.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: STATE-Q1 resolved as BLOCKER because agent_scope is write-enabled and the multi-step fulfillment workflow has no saga or compensation pattern. Steps commit independently.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: The system stores customer PII (names, emails, addresses) in MySQL/RDS with no data residency policies, region restrictions, or compliance framework references. No controls prevent cross-region data transmission.
findings.gap: No data residency configuration, no compliance documentation, no controls for cross-boundary data transmission.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements, add region constraints to IaC, implement controls preventing cross-boundary data transmission to LLM providers.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND PII stored without residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q2 resolved as BLOCKER because agent_scope is write-enabled, the system stores customer PII (email, address), and there are no residency controls or compliance policies. An agent could transmit this data cross-region.

findings.title: Coarse-Grained Permissions
findings.description: The application has only two roles: admin and customer. No mechanism exists to create a scoped agent identity with read-only access to specific resources.
findings.gap: Binary role model. Cannot scope agent to specific resource subsets.
findings.recommendation: Implement granular RBAC with agent-specific roles and configurable endpoint access.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: Authorization checks are role-level only. No action-level differentiation within roles — an admin can perform all operations with no distinction between read, write, and delete.
findings.gap: No ABAC or fine-grained action permissions.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level permission checks on each endpoint.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No JWT/OAuth token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows, no identity propagation. PHP sessions only.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange or delegation mechanism.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credential Fallbacks
findings.description: Hardcoded fallback credentials in code (ecommerce_user/ecommerce_pass). No Secrets Manager or Vault integration. No rotation mechanism.
findings.gap: No secrets management system, hardcoded defaults in source.
findings.recommendation: Integrate AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove hardcoded credential fallbacks.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke an individual agent identity. Only session_destroy() on logout.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without disrupting the entire platform.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-identity suspension with immediate effect on active sessions.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags. Concurrent agent requests could create race conditions on order status updates.
findings.gap: No concurrency control mechanism for concurrent write operations.
findings.recommendation: Add version columns to orders table and implement optimistic locking with conflict detection.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No API-layer rate limiting. WAF has IP whitelisting but no rate-based rules. No application-level throttling.
findings.gap: No protection against runaway agent loops at any layer.
findings.recommendation: Add WAF rate-based rules and application-level per-caller throttling.

findings.title: No Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. No maximum records per operation, no spend caps, no bulk operation size limits.
findings.gap: No business-domain caps on agent operation scope.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller transaction limits for high-impact operations.

findings.title: Approval Gates Not Configurable
findings.description: Approval gates exist for returns and order validation but are hardcoded. Cannot dynamically add approval requirements to other operations.
findings.gap: Approval gates not configurable by operation type. Cannot extend to new operations without code changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement a configurable approval framework where operation types can be flagged as requiring human approval based on rules.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction middleware. PHP error logging enabled. Exception messages could leak connection strings or user data. No log scrubbing or masking.
findings.gap: No PII redaction in logging pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Implement a logging abstraction with PII redaction for emails, names, and addresses.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, or machine-readable specification exists. Endpoints defined only in PHP code.
findings.gap: No machine-readable API spec. Agent tool generation requires manual authoring.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting all REST endpoints.

findings.title: Limited Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses return JSON with error field and HTTP status codes. No error code taxonomy, no retryable indicator, no field-level detail.
findings.gap: No structured error codes or retry classification.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error format with error codes and retryable boolean.

findings.title: No Pagination Support
findings.description: API endpoints return all records without pagination, filtering, or sorting.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets. Agents receive all records regardless of need.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination parameters (limit, offset) to all list endpoints.

findings.title: Minimal Input Validation
findings.description: PDO prepared statements prevent SQL injection. Basic null checks on user creation. No schema validation framework or structured validation error responses.
findings.gap: No systematic input validation or structured validation errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON schema validation middleware with field-level error responses.

findings.title: Limited Temporal Metadata
findings.description: created_at/updated_at fields exist but no timezone normalization documented and no freshness signaling headers.
findings.gap: No freshness indicators or timezone documentation.
findings.recommendation: Normalize to UTC ISO 8601 and add Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No API versioning, no schema registry, no changelog, no contract tests, no breaking change detection.
findings.gap: Agent tool bindings break silently on any API change.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and contract tests.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no structured JSON logging, no correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated requests cannot be traced through the system.
findings.recommendation: Integrate AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry with structured JSON logging.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms for API error rates or latency. Only RDS Enhanced Monitoring configured.
findings.gap: No alerts for API degradation that would affect agents.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms for App Runner HTTP error rates and P99 latency.

findings.title: IaC Without Governance Controls
findings.description: CloudFormation IaC exists but no drift detection, no review process evidence, no change management.
findings.gap: Infrastructure governance incomplete — IaC exists without drift detection or review enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Enable AWS Config drift detection and require PR reviews for IaC changes.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Deployment is manual via deploy.sh (docker-compose up).
findings.gap: No automated testing, no contract validation, no deployment automation.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No deployment rollback mechanism. Manual docker-compose deployment with no automated recovery.
findings.gap: Cannot roll back broken deployments affecting agent-facing APIs.
findings.recommendation: Configure App Runner automatic rollback on health check failure.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests exist. No PHPUnit, no test directories, no API test suites.
findings.gap: No tests. API behavior changes cannot be caught by automation.
findings.recommendation: Implement API integration tests with PHPUnit or Newman.

findings.title: No Event Emission
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, no SNS/EventBridge integration. State changes recorded in database only.
findings.gap: No event-driven notification capability for state changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement EventBridge notifications for order status transitions.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation or headers. No X-RateLimit-Remaining or Retry-After in responses.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on rate limit visibility.
findings.recommendation: Add X-RateLimit-* headers to API responses.

findings.title: No Formal Data Classification Metadata
findings.description: PII stored (email, address). Passwords excluded from API responses. Role-based access differentiates access. However, no formal field-level classification metadata exists.
findings.gap: No formal data classification annotations or sensitivity labels on fields.
findings.recommendation: Add field-level classification annotations identifying PII fields.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to INFO: B1 clear (passwords excluded from API), B2 clear (role-based differentiation), B3 fires as INFO (no formal classification).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 resolved to INFO because B1 and B2 are both clear (passwords excluded from API responses, role-based access differentiation exists). Only B3 fires (no formal classification metadata), which is INFO severity.

b1.reasoning: Passwords excluded from API responses via explicit column selection and session unset.

b2.reasoning: Role-based access (admin/customer) differentiates data access levels.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata, field-level sensitivity annotations, or PII detection tooling.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality monitoring, completeness metrics, or quality signals.
findings.gap: No quality signals for agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality checks on critical fields.

findings.title: No Data Catalog
findings.description: No data catalog, no metadata layer. Schema only in PHP source code.
findings.gap: No discoverable metadata for agent tool builders.
findings.recommendation: Create a data dictionary documenting tables and business semantics.

findings.title: No Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics published. No fulfillment rate or order completion tracking.
findings.gap: Cannot measure agent-driven business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Publish CloudWatch metrics for key business outcomes.

evaluations.title: Documented API Interface
evaluations.reason: Application exposes ~25 REST API endpoints under /api/* with JSON responses. Integration does not require direct DB access or UI automation.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: All API responses use structured JSON with descriptive keys and Content-Type: application/json.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of operations exceeding 30 seconds.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: Multiple GET endpoints expose current state (products, orders, order history, fulfillment status).

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service only calls MySQL, no external service dependencies.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority provided and not on critical path.

evaluations.title: Draft/Pending State
evaluations.reason: System has pending/draft states: returns go to pending_review requiring admin approval, order validation is a separate approval step.

evaluations.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
evaluations.reason: docker-compose.yml provides complete local testing environment with MySQL and seed_data() function for production-equivalent data shape.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: All field names are semantically meaningful (customer_id, order_id, product_name, total_amount). No legacy abbreviations.

evaluations.title: Encryption at Rest
evaluations.reason: RDS StorageEncrypted: true, ECR KMS encryption, VPC Flow Log KMS encryption. All persistent data stores encrypted.

items.summary: Resolve all 5 BLOCKERs and address critical RISK-SAFETY findings related to identity, rate limiting, and PII protection.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings to improve agent effectiveness and enable CI/CD governance.
Address INFO-level findings and remaining quality improvements for full agent readiness.

recommended_actions.action: Implement machine identity authentication (OAuth2 or API keys)
recommended_actions.rationale: Machine identity is the foundation — all other auth controls depend on it. Cannot scope permissions, enforce action-level auth, or attribute audit logs without per-agent identity.

recommended_actions.action: Add idempotency keys to all write endpoints
recommended_actions.rationale: Agents retry on failure and LLMs produce duplicate tool calls. Non-idempotent writes create data integrity risk at machine speed.

recommended_actions.action: Implement saga pattern with compensating transactions
recommended_actions.rationale: Multi-step fulfillment workflow has no compensation logic. Agent-driven partial failures leave the system in an inconsistent state.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy rate limiting and transaction limits
recommended_actions.rationale: No protection against runaway agent loops or unbounded agent operations. Both WAF-level and business-level limits are needed.

recommended_actions.action: Create OpenAPI specification and implement CI/CD pipeline
recommended_actions.rationale: Machine-readable API spec enables automated tool generation. CI/CD with contract tests prevents silent agent breakage.
